maintenance_led.reason: Sells oral controlled-release generic drugs (new product sales), not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Generic drugs sold via wholesalers and pharmacies to consumers and private payers; no majority government contract revenue evident.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own generic development and manufacturing in Northvale NJ, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Niche generic drugs have alternative suppliers; customers can switch to other generic makers fairly easily.

notes: Government payer share is not stated on the site; that answer is a judgment.
